items.title: Use of Machine Learning in Business (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Use of Machine Learning in Business' under topic 6.5 (PDF 81, printed 77).

blocks.text: Businesses machine learning se customers ka rawaiya (behavior) samajhte hain. Yeh sales (farokht) aur market ke trends ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai, aur inventory management (stock ka hisab) mein bhi kaam aati hai. Misalein: financial systems mein fraud (dhoka) pakarna, robots ya chatbots ke zariye customer service, aur customers ko products tajweez karna. Machine learning se marketing ki strategies zyada asar-dar ho jati hain, aur business ke faisle data par mabni (data-driven) ho jate hain. Is se munafa (profit) aur efficiency barhti hai.
